abort.already_configured: This AstralPool connection is already configured.

abort.restart_started: The Smart Next restart has started in the background. AstralPool will become temporarily unavailable for about 70–100 seconds and will reconnect automatically.
abort.maintenance_ok: The Smart Next confirmed the maintenance operation.
abort.maintenance_e2: The Smart Next returned calibration error E2: the detected value is too far from the expected value.
abort.maintenance_e3: The Smart Next returned calibration error E3: the measurement is unstable.
abort.maintenance_unavailable: The requested calibration is not available on this Smart Next configuration.
abort.maintenance_initializing: The Smart Next is still initializing and rejected the calibration operation.
abort.maintenance_first_point_ok: The Smart Next returned the first-point calibration status instead of a reset confirmation.
abort.maintenance_timeout: No calibration result was received before the timeout.
abort.maintenance_response_not_cleared: The previous calibration result could not be cleared.
abort.maintenance_unsupported: This maintenance procedure is not supported.
abort.maintenance_communication_failed: Communication with the Smart Next failed during the maintenance procedure.
abort.maintenance_failed: The Smart Next maintenance procedure failed.

abort.orp_ok: 470 mV Redox / ORP calibration completed successfully and the installation was restored.

abort.orp_reset_ok: The factory Redox / ORP calibration was restored successfully.

error.confirmation_required: Confirm the requested step before continuing.
error.calibration_communication_failed: Communication with the Smart Next failed during calibration. Keep the installation in a safe state and retry only after communication is restored.
error.calibration_e2: E2 — the detected value is too far from the expected calibration value.
error.calibration_e3: E3 — the measurement is unstable. Clean the probe, gently agitate it in the reference solution and wait for a stable reading before retrying.
error.calibration_unavailable: Calibration unavailable (IR 0x22 = 4). Check the current Smart Next state and retry.
error.calibration_initializing: The sensor is still initializing (IR 0x22 = 5). Wait until it is ready before retrying.
error.calibration_mode_lost: Calibration mode ended before a usable result was captured.
error.calibration_timeout: No calibration response was received before the timeout.
error.calibration_failed: The Smart Next returned an unexpected calibration result.
error.calibration_mode_not_active: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be activated.
error.treatment_not_halted: The Smart Next did not confirm Treatment halted after entering calibration mode.
error.calibration_response_not_cleared: IR 0x22 could not be cleared while calibration mode was active.
error.electrolysis_not_stopped: Electrolysis could not be verified fully stopped. The hydraulic procedure is blocked.
error.calibration_mode_rearm_failed: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be re-armed after the Smart Next released it. Production remains forced to 0 %. Restore the hydraulic installation immediately.
error.calibration_mode_rearm_too_slow: Calibration mode remained inactive for 10 seconds or more. Production remains forced to 0 %. Restore the hydraulic installation immediately.
error.flow_not_restored: Normal water flow through the electrolyzer has not been confirmed. Production remains at 0 %; correct the valves/circulation and retry the final restoration step.

maintenance.title: Smart Next maintenance
maintenance.description: Choose a guided maintenance procedure. Only procedures supported by the detected Smart Next hardware are shown.

maintenance_confirm.title: Confirm maintenance procedure
maintenance_confirm.description: The selected operation writes directly to the Smart Next over local Modbus. Confirm only if you want to execute the selected procedure now.

data.confirm: I understand and want to execute this procedure

calibrate_sensor.title: Calibrate a Smart Next sensor
calibrate_sensor.description: Choose a hardware-validated calibration procedure. Salinity remains available only through the raw Calibration TEST entities until its sequence is validated.

calibrate_ph.title: pH calibration
calibrate_ph.description: Fast calibration corrects the installed probe from a trusted reference measurement. Standard calibration removes the probe and uses pH 7 then pH 4 reference solutions.

calibrate_ph_fast.title: pH — Fast calibration
calibrate_ph_fast.description: Leave the pH probe installed and keep normal circulation running. Current Smart Next pH: {current_ph}. Enter a trusted reference pH. Home Assistant activates 0x201, clears IR 0x22 with 0x203, writes reference ×100 to HR 0x22, triggers 0x50F and displays the result.

calibrate_ph_standard_prepare.title: pH Standard — Software safety
calibrate_ph_standard_prepare.description: Keep filtration RUNNING and all valves in their NORMAL operating position. Before any hydraulic manipulation, Home Assistant saves the current Smart Next state, disables the logical flow inputs and known electrolysis overrides, forces normal production to 0 %, and verifies production = 0, current = 0 and electrolysis stopped. Calibration mode 0x201 is NOT started yet.

data.confirm: Normal circulation is active; secure electrolysis at 0 %

calibrate_ph_standard_filtration_off.title: pH Standard — Preparation 1/6 · Stop filtration
calibrate_ph_standard_filtration_off.description: Switch OFF the filtration pump. Check physically that the pump has stopped before validating this step. Electrolysis remains independently forced to 0 % by AstralPool.

data.filtration_off: The filtration pump is OFF and I have checked that it is stopped

calibrate_ph_standard_bypass_open.title: pH Standard — Preparation 2/6 · Open bypass
calibrate_ph_standard_bypass_open.description: Fully OPEN the electrolyzer bypass valve, then validate.

data.bypass_open: The electrolyzer bypass valve is OPEN

calibrate_ph_standard_inlet_closed.title: pH Standard — Preparation 3/6 · Close inlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_inlet_closed.description: CLOSE the valve upstream of the electrolyzer, on the probe/inlet side, then validate.

calibrate_ph_standard_outlet_closed.title: pH Standard — Preparation 4/6 · Close outlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_outlet_closed.description: CLOSE the valve downstream of the electrolyzer, at the electrolyzer outlet, then validate. The electrolyzer section is now isolated between the two closed valves.

calibrate_ph_standard_probe_loosened.title: pH Standard — Preparation 5/6 · Loosen the pH probe
calibrate_ph_standard_probe_loosened.description: Slightly unscrew the pH probe you are going to remove. Do not remove it completely yet. Validate when it is only loosened.

data.probe_loosened: The pH probe is slightly loosened but still in place

calibrate_ph_standard_drain_pulse.title: pH Standard — Preparation 6/6 · Lower the water level
calibrate_ph_standard_drain_pulse.description: Very slightly OPEN the downstream/outlet valve for no more than 2 seconds, allowing a small amount of air into the isolated section so the water level drops, then CLOSE the valve again immediately. Never leave it open for more than 2 seconds. Validate only after the outlet valve is CLOSED again. Home Assistant will then start the validated calibration session: 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0.

data.drain_done: I opened the outlet valve for at most 2 seconds and it is CLOSED again

calibrate_ph_standard_ph7.title: pH Standard — Calibration 1/2 · pH 7
calibrate_ph_standard_ph7.description: Calibration mode is active and IR 0x22 has been cleared. Now fully remove the pH probe, rinse/clean it, immerse it in fresh pH 7 reference solution, gently agitate it and wait about 30 seconds until stable. Current reading: {current_ph}. Validate to trigger 0x50D. IR 0x22 = 16 means the first point was accepted and 0x201 remains active for pH 4.

data.stable: The probe is clean, in pH 7 solution and the reading is stable

calibrate_ph_standard_ph4.title: pH Standard — Calibration 2/2 · pH 4
calibrate_ph_standard_ph4.description: Rinse/clean the probe again, immerse it in fresh pH 4 reference solution, gently agitate it and wait about 30 seconds until stable. Current reading: {current_ph}. Validate to trigger 0x50E. IR 0x22 = 1 means success. The Smart Next normally releases 0x201 at this point; AstralPool re-arms it immediately while the isolated electrolyzer has not yet been restored.

data.stable: The probe is clean, in pH 4 solution and the reading is stable

calibrate_ph_standard_error.title: pH Standard — Calibration error
calibrate_ph_standard_error.description: Result: {error}. A terminal error can release 0x201 and allow production to resume. AstralPool therefore re-arms 0x201 immediately and keeps the separate 0 % production lock active. Calibration mode must not remain inactive for 10 seconds. Retry from pH 7 or restore the installation safely.

calibrate_ph_standard_restore.title: pH Standard — Restoration 1/5 · Reinstall probe
calibrate_ph_standard_restore.description: Rinse the pH probe if necessary, reinstall it fully and tighten it correctly while both electrolyzer isolation valves remain closed and filtration remains OFF.

data.probe_installed: The pH probe is fully reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_inlet.title: pH Standard — Restoration 2/5 · Open inlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_inlet.description: With filtration still OFF and the bypass still OPEN, fully OPEN the upstream/inlet valve of the electrolyzer.

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_outlet.title: pH Standard — Restoration 3/5 · Open outlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_outlet.description: Fully OPEN the downstream/outlet valve of the electrolyzer. Both isolation valves must now be open.

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_bypass.title: pH Standard — Restoration 4/5 · Close bypass
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_bypass.description: CLOSE the electrolyzer bypass valve to return the hydraulic circuit to its normal operating path through the electrolyzer.

data.bypass_closed: The bypass valve is CLOSED and the hydraulic path is normal

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_filtration.title: pH Standard — Restoration 5/5 · Restart filtration
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_filtration.description: Switch the filtration pump back ON and verify that it is really running and water is circulating through the electrolyzer. After confirmation, Home Assistant restores the logical flow sensors, verifies Smart Next flow, releases 0x201, and only then restores the previous electrolysis settings.

data.filtration_on: Filtration is ON and circulation through the electrolyzer is confirmed

calibrate_orp_prepare.title: Redox / ORP — Software safety
calibrate_orp_prepare.description: Keep filtration RUNNING and all valves in their NORMAL position. Home Assistant first saves the Smart Next state, disables logical flow inputs and known electrolysis overrides, forces normal production to 0 %, and verifies production = 0, current = 0 and electrolysis stopped. Calibration mode 0x201 is NOT started yet.

data.confirm: Normal circulation is active; secure electrolysis at 0 %

calibrate_orp_filtration_off.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 1/6 · Stop filtration
calibrate_orp_filtration_off.description: Switch OFF the filtration pump. Check physically that the pump has stopped before validating.

data.filtration_off: The filtration pump is OFF and I have checked that it is stopped

calibrate_orp_bypass_open.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 2/6 · Open bypass
calibrate_orp_bypass_open.description: Fully OPEN the electrolyzer bypass valve, then validate.

data.bypass_open: The electrolyzer bypass valve is OPEN

calibrate_orp_inlet_closed.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 3/6 · Close inlet valve
calibrate_orp_inlet_closed.description: CLOSE the valve upstream of the electrolyzer, on the probe/inlet side, then validate.

calibrate_orp_outlet_closed.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 4/6 · Close outlet valve
calibrate_orp_outlet_closed.description: CLOSE the downstream/outlet valve of the electrolyzer, then validate. The electrolyzer section is now isolated.

calibrate_orp_probe_loosened.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 5/6 · Loosen ORP probe
calibrate_orp_probe_loosened.description: Slightly unscrew the ORP probe. Do not remove it completely yet. Validate when it is only loosened.

data.probe_loosened: The ORP probe is slightly loosened but still in place

calibrate_orp_drain_pulse.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 6/6 · Lower the water level
calibrate_orp_drain_pulse.description: Very slightly OPEN the downstream/outlet valve for no more than 2 seconds so a small amount of air enters and the water level drops, then CLOSE it immediately. Never leave it open for more than 2 seconds. Validate only after the outlet valve is CLOSED again. Home Assistant then starts 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0.

data.drain_done: I opened the outlet valve for at most 2 seconds and it is CLOSED again

calibrate_orp_470.title: Redox / ORP — Calibration at 470 mV
calibrate_orp_470.description: Calibration mode is active and IR 0x22 has been cleared. Fully remove and clean the ORP probe. Immerse it in fresh 470 mV reference solution at approximately 25 °C, gently agitate it and wait about 30 seconds for a stable reading. Current reading: {current_orp} mV. Validate to trigger 0x80F. IR 0x22 = 1 means success. AstralPool immediately re-arms 0x201 after any terminal result while the electrolyzer remains isolated.

data.stable: The probe is clean, in 470 mV solution and the reading is stable

calibrate_orp_error.title: Redox / ORP — Calibration error
calibrate_orp_error.description: Result: {error}. A terminal error can release 0x201. AstralPool re-arms it immediately and keeps electrolysis independently forced to 0 %. Calibration mode must not remain inactive for 10 seconds. Retry at 470 mV or restore the installation safely.

calibrate_orp_restore.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 1/5 · Reinstall probe
calibrate_orp_restore.description: Rinse the ORP probe if necessary, reinstall it fully and tighten it correctly while both isolation valves remain closed and filtration remains OFF.

data.probe_installed: The ORP probe is fully reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_orp_restore_inlet.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 2/5 · Open inlet valve
calibrate_orp_restore_inlet.description: With filtration still OFF and bypass still OPEN, fully OPEN the upstream/inlet valve.

calibrate_orp_restore_outlet.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 3/5 · Open outlet valve
calibrate_orp_restore_outlet.description: Fully OPEN the downstream/outlet valve. Both electrolyzer isolation valves must now be open.

calibrate_orp_restore_bypass.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 4/5 · Close bypass
calibrate_orp_restore_bypass.description: CLOSE the electrolyzer bypass valve so the hydraulic path is again through the electrolyzer.

data.bypass_closed: The bypass valve is CLOSED and the hydraulic path is normal

calibrate_orp_restore_filtration.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 5/5 · Restart filtration
calibrate_orp_restore_filtration.description: Switch the filtration pump back ON and verify real circulation through the electrolyzer. Home Assistant then restores logical flow sensors, checks Smart Next flow, releases 0x201, and only afterwards restores the previous electrolysis state.

data.filtration_on: Filtration is ON and circulation through the electrolyzer is confirmed

restore_calibration.title: Restore factory calibration
restore_calibration.description: Choose a hardware-validated sensor calibration reset.

restore_ph_calibration.title: Restore factory pH calibration
restore_ph_calibration.description: Keep the probe installed and normal circulation active. Home Assistant performs the validated sequence 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0 → pH reset 0x50C. IR 0x22 = 1 confirms success and the Smart Next normally releases 0x201 automatically.

data.confirm: Restore the factory pH calibration now

restore_orp_calibration.title: Restore factory Redox / ORP calibration
restore_orp_calibration.description: Keep the probe installed and normal circulation active. Home Assistant performs the validated sequence 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0 → ORP reset 0x80C. IR 0x22 = 1 confirms success and the Smart Next normally releases 0x201 automatically.

data.confirm: Restore the factory Redox / ORP calibration now

calibrate_temperature.title: Temperature calibration
calibrate_temperature.description: Enter the trusted reference water temperature. The validated sequence writes reference ×10 to HR 0x22, triggers 0xB0F and waits 5 seconds.

alarm_count_cooling_pipe_too_high.name: Counters · cooling pipe temperature too high

alarm_gas_exhaust_too_high.name: Alarm · gas discharge temperature too high
